lc_person: Constantine R. (Constantine Rudyard) Jurgėla, born 1904; historian and author of Lithuania and the U.S. (1985), based on his Fordham dissertation.
item_person: Konstantinas Rudaminas Jurgėla (1904–1988), historian; the same author under a different name form.

evidence.says: LC gives Constantine R. (Constantine Rudyard) Jurgėla, 1904-, with variant Constantine Rudyard Jurgela. Its source is Lithuania and the U.S. (1985). It links Q16456753, VIAF 92409323 and ISNI 0000000109249150.
The item labels the historian Konstantinas Rudaminas Jurgėla, gives birth year 1904 and death year 1988, and carries LC n88074133, VIAF 92409323 and ISNI 0000000109249150, matching LC.

The encyclopedia identifies Konstantinas Rudaminas Jurgėla as a historian, records history studies at Fordham in 1951–1954 and a doctorate in 1954, and lists Lithuania and the United States (1985). It prints the birth year as 1904(?).

The library catalogue attributes Lithuania and the United States: the establishment of state relations (1985) to Constantine R. (Constantine Rudyard) Jurgėla and identifies it as a revision of his Fordham University Ph.D. thesis, 1954. This matches the AHA dissertation title, institution and year in key_evidence.

Fordham repository metadata names Constantine R. Jurgela as author of Lithuania and the United States: The Establishment of State Relations, a Fordham Ph.D. dissertation. The repository dates it 1953.

notes: The name disagreement reflects different name forms; matching works and shared identifiers establish the identity. LC and Wikidata agree on 1904, although the encyclopedia qualifies it with a question mark. Fordham dates the dissertation 1953; AHA and the library catalogue give 1954. This date variation does not indicate a different author.
